name: Everything You've Ever Dreamed
source:
I'm lonely.

I'm so lonely that even talking about it feels so trite because I've already exhausted every angle with which to explore the topic. I don't care anymore. I just want to feel close to someone without being afraid.

[From [url=https://moonscraps.itch.io/berceuse]itch.io[/url]]
